## Pre-release routing and promotion gate

Read `planning/pre-release.md`. Ordinary work targets `pre-release`; evidence or
manuscript promotion targets `main` only after the exact changes are cleared.

PR kind: staging / evidence promotion / governance-only maintenance.
Base branch and inspected base SHA: ...
Head branch and inspected head SHA: ...
Staged source commit(s) and exact promoted file/blob list: ...
Review-record link (use `planning/pre-release-review.template.md`): ...
Actual human editorial decision and its exact scope, or NOT YET GIVEN: ...

- [ ] Every material changed claim/exhibit has a linked verification issue and an explicit presentation/verification disposition.
- [ ] Sources, quotations, calculations, inherited assertions and contrary material were checked at the scope claimed.
- [ ] Material allegations have a documented response-opportunity disposition; no unsent request is represented as contact and silence is not agreement.
- [ ] Privacy, rights, disclosure grants, RF-01 and the protected closing were reviewed for this exact payload.
- [ ] No unresolved blocking claim enters `main`; a partial promotion excludes all uncleared changes.
- [ ] The current diff, base/head and substantive review agree; a later change requires renewed review.

For staging, identify pending items rather than checking them as passed. For
purely operational maintenance, explain why a criterion is not applicable; that
classification cannot exempt new narrative or factual assertions. A template,
checkbox, bot output or agent-authored comment is not human editorial approval.
Native enforcement is pending #311; do not represent this template as a GitHub
branch-protection setting. No auto-merge or final-edition release is implied.

## Work and authority
Primary work issue: ...
Author instruction/source: ...
This is an agent-prepared PR, not a human approval. One PR for this response.

## Changes and disclosure
Exact scope and artifacts; source classification; applicable disclosure permission. No private source payload or PR-01 leakage in descriptions, tests or logs.

## Verification
Commands actually run, tested version, results and limitations. State when CI or human review has not run; do not invent approval.

## Blockers
Blocked by: #ISSUE (affected stage and resolution condition), or none after live review.
Human acceptance deferred to: ...

## Completion
Use `Closes #N` only when all of work issue N is complete. For partial work use `Refs #N` and leave it open. Never auto-close a human gate. Merge only after required checks, valid scope and source permissions are confirmed for the inspected head SHA. Record the actual merge result afterward. No auto-release.

## RF-01 framing review
- [ ] The actual task remains relational description, not an imposed racism claim or defense.
- [ ] Supplied identities, source status and unknown links remain visible; motive, operator and label are not description prerequisites.
- [ ] Original sources remain unchanged; current derivatives and superseded review notes have exact lineage.
- [ ] Contributions can correct the record without giving author or institution exclusive truth.
- [ ] Limited automated checks and the actual semantic reread are reported separately; no guarantee or human approval is inferred.

Read `planning/relational-framing.md` and #98–#100. The author has already supplied this correction.
